name: cat
summary: Prints and concatenates the contents of files.
description: Reads the files in order and writes their contents to standard output. Without a file, or with “-”, it reads standard input. Its name comes from “concatenate”: cat a b > c merges two files.

options.description: Squeezes runs of blank lines into one.
Makes invisible characters visible: $ at the end of a line, ^I for a tab.
Prints $ at the end of each line.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) to read. “-” means standard input.

examples.explanation: Prints a script with line numbers.
Merges two files into a third one.
